7.5.2.4 Segmentation condition for data transfer
[SWS_FrTp_01068]
⌈
If
the
FrTpConnectionControl
parameter
FRTP_MULTIPLE_RECEIVER_CON  (see section 10.2) for the
corresponding FrTpConnection is set, the communication handler
shall not process a segmentation of an N-SDU and take the following
actions:
a) shall raise a runtime error FRTP_E_SEG_ERROR and
b) shall abort the transmission of this message and notify the upper
layer by calling the callback function PduR_FrTpTxConfirmation with
the result E_NOT_OK.⌋()
caption: 7.5.2.4 Segmentation condition for data transfer
